context: Following D-01M6CG6W9M6GN70AW52REH71SZ and D-01M6CYQ0JFG84Y6JXY78QBM485. agent draft (S3) requires the body headings Objective, Procedure, Report, Stop when, Do not, Example in that order and the BLOCKED report shape (Status: BLOCKED, Decision needed:, Options:). The six stage agents (paqad-planning, paqad-specification, paqad-development, paqad-review, paqad-checks, paqad-documentation-sync) use Your stage brief / What you were dispatched with / Run your stage / Report; paqad-expert and paqad-chief-architect use their own headings; each exists in .claude/agents and runtime/claude-plugin/agents. runtime/templates/stage-agents/claude.md.hbs (agent name claude) is a Handlebars template whose body is a placeholder. S3 is not in the approved override list, so no agent reaches S4 and no authoring.agent_permission packet (Bash, AG-022) has been raised yet. paqad-checks was tried first: it holds S0/S1/S2/S5/S6 overrides and its S3 trace is failed. Rewriting the stage agent bodies changes how every paqad stage agent is prompted.
